gold_note: Eusauropod strict consensus, read in five bands at 2x from the 175 dpi raster. Clade names (Eusauropoda, Mamenchisauridae, Turiasauria, Neosauropoda, Diplodocoidea, Dicraeosauridae, Diplodocidae, Rebbachisauridae, Khebbashia, Nigersaurinae, Macronaria, Brachiosauridae, Titanosauriformes, Somphospondyli, Titanosauria, Euhelopodidae, Lithostrotia, Longkosauria) are kept on the nodes beside which they are printed. Polytomies: the root (Shunosaurus, Omeisaurus and the rest), Khebbashia (five), the Abydosaurus group (four), the Andesaurus group (four), Titanosauria's inner node (five: Euhelopodidae, Angolatitan, Gobititan, Huanghetitan ruyangensis and the rest), the Longkosauria crown and the three-way Futalognkosaurus node. 112 tips, 8 polytomies (3, 3, 5, 4, 4, 5, 3, 3 children); 18 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 9 case (census 3, seed 20261272). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
